core.title: Back-To-Back Rail Pull Set, Pair, Emtek BTB-86349
tags: Emtek Rail Sandcast Bronze Pull Sets

text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86349, Rail Back-to-Back Handle Pair

The Back-To-Back Rail Pull Set has a simple outline that only emphasizes its industrial chic look. This Rail Back-to-Back Handle Pair is the obvious choice for your rustic industrial renovation project. Choose from 12 inch and 18 inch lengths. It will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick; and the Rail Sandcast Bronze Pull Pair comes packaged as a set of 2 handles and the necessary back-to-back mounting hardware. It is available in matte black, medium bronze, and tumbled white bronze finishes

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Rail Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Rail Sandcast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Sandcast Bronze
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.
  • Emtek Rail Pull Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available in 2 Sizes:

    EMT-BTB-86349:
    • Total Length: 12-3/4"
    • Center to Center Length: 12"
    • Pull Handle Width: 9/16"
    • Total Projection: 2"
    • Base: 13/16"

    EMT-BTB-86350:
    • Total Length: 18-3/4"
    • Center to Center Length: 18"
    • Pull Handle Width: 9/16"
    • Total Projection: 2"
    • Base: 13/16"

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
